version.changelog: Added the first Hermes-style OpenClaw loop with setup, memory, workspace seed, and promotion rules.

llm.summary: This skill creates a local learning loop for OpenClaw and its persistence is disclosed, scoped, and aligned with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: The requested local files and workspace seed edits are proportionate to a persistence-oriented agent skill, with no executable scripts, no dependency requirements, and no network requests by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The setup creates ~/hermes-agent/ files and gives small additive patches for AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, and HEARTBEAT.md; workspace and main OpenClaw memory edits require asking first.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The loop can activate for non-trivial or repeated work and says not to narrate the loop unless asked, but the scope is bounded to operational lessons and excludes trivial chat, secrets, sensitive personal data, and broad support-file loading.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally stores durable local reflections and rules under ~/hermes-agent/ and may influence future sessions, so users should review what is stored even though the behavior is disclosed and locally scoped.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is reflective memory, workspace seeding, and promotion of repeated workflows; the inspected files implement that through local markdown memory files and additive OpenClaw seed blocks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want OpenClaw to keep a durable local memory of operational lessons. Review ~/hermes-agent/ periodically, avoid storing sensitive details there, and use the built-in preference options if you want Hermes behavior only after failures, only on request, or disabled for certain projects.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger conditions are broad, but they are part of the disclosed learning-loop purpose and are narrowed by skipping trivial replies and reading only memory.md plus at most one relevant support file.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent writes to reflections.md and memory.md are core to the skill; the artifact adds boundaries against secrets, sensitive data, copied transcripts, and noisy logging, though users should still periodically review these files.
[EA2] unexpected: The cited text is a list of bad promotion candidates and does not authorize destructive, financial, public-posting, or other high-impact actions without confirmation.
